title: Add bounded local lookup tools
description: Add allowlisted project-file search/read and scoped memory retrieval with schemas, output limits and source references. An external web lookup is optional until a provider is selected. Keep execution timeout, cancellation and permission handling consistent across tools. Do not expose unrestricted shell access to the supervising model.
why: The supervisor needs enough evidence to answer and delegate accurately.

acceptance.text: A lookup cites its actual source
Oversized output is bounded with a follow-up path
Path escape and unrelated workspace reads are rejected
Tool errors are visible and do not become invented answers

outcome.summary: Added bounded read-only local project search, byte-paginated file reads, and explicit-scope memory lookup with source references. Sensitive paths, excluded directories, traversal and binary files are rejected; search reports incomplete scans and errors.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; npm run test:plantool; npm run test:context
